place_binding: Use only with the exact public-demo place and source-run receipt supplied at build time.

registration.label: Authored natural-border registration candidate
registration.claim_boundary: The line is authored to exercise the registration kernel. It is not a curb, property line, roof edge, vegetation boundary, drainage feature, fuel break, access route, work limit, observed geometry, or field record.

map_only.safe_action: Use the public map and terrain context, preserve every failed street-provider reason, and request an authorized source or site capture when street-direction, visibility, recency, or registration matters.
map_only.authority: Map-only mode provides public context and source-coverage status. It does not establish current street condition, access, ownership, boundary, safety, inspection, work, or completion authority.
map_only.prohibited_consequence: No fabricated street scene, field finding, property consequence, insurance decision, enforcement action, dispatch, or completed-remediation claim.

prohibited_uses: presentation as observed or provider street imagery
physical-feature, property, legal, access, hazard, safety, or work-boundary identification
inspection, entry, traffic, pruning, dispatch, work, completion, insurance, enforcement, or other adverse action
public release or canonical task-count mutation
control_question: Can an operator use this line only as an authored search seed, inspect the source-image evidence and displacement receipt, and refuse to name or operationalize the edge without separate evidence and authority?
